a.lede: The Taipei 101 skyscraper was lit up with messages of support for Jensen Huang overnight, the former Nvidia CEO who left the company after admitting to an affair with a former customer who has been accused of being a Chinese Spy. Another affair, this time with an employee, has since been reported.
a.title: Taipei 101 lit up in support of Jensen Huang

b.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ to return to Nvidia as CEO
